title: Contextual first-steps for Rollout & Cost Cards (empty states + microcopy)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and prototype a set of contextual "first steps" experiences that appear in empty or low-data states for two high-impact Console surfaces: Rollout cards (canary/A-B) and Cost summary cards. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-success, lower support queries about "where to start", and increase feature activation for rollouts and cost controls.
goal: Deliver lightweight, non-intrusive in-product education patterns (tooltips, inline guides, reveal cards, quick templates) tailored to rollout and cost surfaces. Provide final Figma screens and a development-ready spec with copy, interaction states, and accessibility notes.
updates: 2026-03-01 Ava Martinez: Kickoff — aligned with PM and Eng on scope. Focus surfaces: Rollout card empty state, Cost overview card when no billing data, and quick 'apply template' CTA for cost guardrails.

2026-03-03 Jordan Lee: Initial sketches uploaded to Figma; explored three patterns: inline microcopy, dismissible reveal card, and short guided tour. Marked accessibility considerations for color contrast and keyboard focus order.

2026-03-04 Maya Thompson (PM): Reviewed patterns; prefers reveal card for rollouts to support live preview and single-click canary creation. Asked to include copy variants for enterprise and self-serve orgs.

2026-03-05 Kai Patel (Eng): Flagged dependency — rollout-preview API endpoint (ENG-2283) needed to show live sample; without it we'll use mocked preview and add a fallback CTA linking to the Rollouts quickstart.

2026-03-06 Design review: Consolidated to two patterns: (A) Compact reveal card with primary CTA and contextual example, (B) Inline microcopy + subtle tooltip for cost cards to avoid obscuring billing charts. Updated Figma with detailed states.

2026-03-07 Usability test plan uploaded. Recruiting 6 participants (mix of PM/FE/Backend engineers). Focus on time-to-complete scenario: 'Create a canary rollout' and 'Set a budget alert using cost template'.
2026-03-08 Jordan Lee: Submitted design for engineering handoff (WIP). Noted outstanding copy variants and telemetry events to be added for analytics. Assigned follow-ups to ENG-2283 and PM-512.
usability_findings: Participants preferred fewer modal steps — reveal card that surfaces example config reduced confusion.
Copy that used concrete numbers ("limit to 5 requests/min") tested better than abstract phrases ("set a limit").
Users wanted a clear 'what happens next' line after clicking CTA — added microcopy explaining rollout preview and dry-run behavior.
feedback_and_decisions: Decision: Use reveal card pattern for Rollouts to enable a live preview and single-click creation.
Decision: Use inline microcopy + infobutton for Cost cards to keep chart visibility.
Feedback: PM requested enterprise copy variants and a security callout for on-prem customers.
next_steps: Run moderated usability sessions (2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13) and synthesize findings.
Finalize copy variants (self-serve, enterprise, on-prem) and update Figma frames.
Provision analytics events and telemetry schema with Eng for activation tracking (ENG-2283).
Create final dev handoff ticket with interaction specs, aria-labels, and animation timings.
Coordinate a small beta release for 10% of orgs with PM to validate activation and support volume.
blocking_issues: Rollout preview API not available for live sample (ENG-2283)
Missing final copy owners for enterprise variants
notes: Aim for lightweight patterns that nudge users to success without adding noisy banners. Track activation rate and support ticket volume post-release to measure impact. Ensure all text is localizable and that templates respect org-level defaults.
